Messages.Author: Dougal Campbell
Messages.Body:
In article <330vh0$hme@giga.bga.com>, Phil Hall said something like:
> Is it just me or are the card symbols that sre supposed to be on the 
> right border are actually on the left?

My bet is that between the time the rules were sent to the printer
and the time that the cards were sent to the printer, WotC figured out
that if you put the icons on the left, they'll be visible on all of 
your hand's cards.  Assuming that you hold them in the traditional
"poker hand" spreading.  And perhaps assuming right-handedness.

Actually, this was pointed out by Mike Helba (m.helba@genie.com),
to give credit where it is due.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The symbols were originally planned to be where the rulebook says
they are, until someone realized that the way most people fan their
cards in their hand, that would make the symbols hidden and thus
unreadable, which is bad.  Thus, the symbols got moved to the left
side of the card, but for whatever reason, the rulebook never got
updated.  The corrected rulebook displays the cards' format correctly.


Tom Wylie		rec.games.deckmaster Network Representative for
